label: Vortex (Nexus Mods)
source: field:2026-11-20 Vortex 2.8.0, started by CIG with --user-data <test folder>

system_side_effects.note: Even on a separate, fresh --user-data folder Vortex makes itself the nxm:// handler at start-up (seen 2026-11-20: MO2's nxmhandler.exe was replaced). CIG exports these keys before the launch and restores them when it closes the program.
